problem_statement: Provide a PPTX conversion service for users using scheduled and background workers on AWS EKS; conversions may fail, so we need to retain logs, be able to modify code and rerun, and provide a complete deployment plan.
constraints: Nature of work: Schedule-driven (can include manual rerun)
Workload: PPTX → other formats, long-running, error-prone
Must be auditable: Status and history logs
Must be re-executable: Includes rerun semantics after code fixes
acceptance_criteria: Task and step status persisted and queryable (who, when, which version, which input artifact)
Failures can be retried; poison messages/duplicate processing are defined (idempotency / DLQ)
Clear paths for scheduled (cron/event) and manual rerun/makeup run
Deployment includes the minimal closed loop of queue, worker, scheduler, storage, and observability on EKS
Can explain 'how to rerun after code modification': the relationship between the new version workflow and old tasks
